fields.name: def6
fields.fieldText:
Cultural Alignment

Understanding and ability to cater to the buyer’s company culture


﻿Digital Transformation

Ability to understand, simplify and enhance the buyer’s digital transformation strategy, e.g., transformative and innovative approach to automation, analytics, consulting, channels, etc.


Knowledge & Experience

Confidence across Alorica’s capabilities to adequately deliver the solution, e.g., solid understanding of the buyer’s business and how best to support it, industry/operations expertise, etc.


Language

Range and availability to deliver language support to the buyer, e.g., specific language requirements were met, in-country language support was in scope, etc.

fields.name: Def5
fields.fieldText:
Market Geography

How well Alorica’s geography footprint and solution (site selection, WAH offering) met buyer’s requirements, e.g., proximity to customer base as requested, proximity to current vendors, etc.


Performance

Historical performance impacted the buyer’s decision, e.g., did Alorica’s previous performance achieve the main tasks and functions the client intended?


Price

Overall pricing quoted for the solution contributed to the outcome, e.g., price was too high/low


Relationship

Responsiveness and engagement of Alorica’s account team, e.g., level of involvement across stakeholder teams, leaders, sense of partnership, etc.

fields.name: defs3
fields.fieldText:
Buyer Discontinued

Wrong timing and / or the opportunity is on hold. The expectation is that the buyer will re-open the opportunity in the future.


Didn’t Meet ICP

Prospect did not meet Alorica’s ideal customer profile standards.


Opportunity Too Small

Revenue and/or FTE amount was not material enough to continue opportunity pursuit.


ROI & Perceived Value for Alorica

Alorica opted out e.g., Low/no value to Alorica, could not negotiate penalty, etc.

fields.name: defs4
fields.fieldText:
ROI & Perceived Value for Client

Did the solution offer a compelling value proposition that incented their supplier decision, did Alorica fail to make a business case to move forward, will the buyer receive increase in revenue/profit by hiring Alorica


Salesforce Record Cleanup

Duplicate entry, placeholder, reassignment, etc.


Stakeholder Misalignment

Key internal and/or external stakeholders could not agree on critical elements of the opportunity.


Unresponsive Contact

﻿Primary opportunity decision maker has not communicated/responded for a period greater than 90 days.
